correctness.rationale: Over finite characteristic-two fields every diagonal entry of an element squaring to 1 is 1. The incidence-algebra support forces the precise three-block form and N²=0 iff AB=0. For fixed ranks of A and B the rank of N is r+s+rank(pi C restricted to ker B). The restriction-and-quotient map on C is surjective with a kernel of dimension ac-(a-r)(c-s), proving the Gaussian rank multiplicity formula without extrapolation. Independent full matrix enumeration for ten small-field cases over q=2,3,4 checks the intermediate square-zero formula; q=3 tests only linear algebra, not characteristic-two involutions.

originality.rationale: Direct original incidence-algebra paper Gargate–Gargate arXiv:1907.06805v1, inspected in full HTML, assumes characteristic unequal to two and cannot yield the characteristic-two rank formula by its signs-and-inverses recurrence. Fornaroli–Pezzott arXiv:2209.09690v1 concerns anti-automorphisms, not involutive elements. Wu–Zhou arXiv:2609.00533v1 announces aggregate rank counts for all upper-triangular square-zero matrices; publicly accessible abstract does not imply rank-by-rank counts for a fixed three-level poset support. Search comparisons revealed no stronger claimed fixed-pattern formula; full 2026 text and alternative parabolic literature remain residual risks.

value.rationale: Determines a complete, natural conjugacy-invariant Jordan-block statistic for every order-two incidence unit of all complete three-level posets over every even finite field, extending the direct prior literature into a characteristic where its method fails. The formula uses a meaningful stratification by maps, kernels and images rather than an arbitrary finite slice or a trivial binomial count; it also supplies the exact total cardinality. A sharp characteristic distinction and practical rank coefficients are mathematically motivated.
